segments.text: Tata Tiago, are you watching? The Swift is back!
Packing 82 PS of power under the hood, this Swift isn't just fast, it's furious!
And with 111.7 Nm of torque, you'll be glued to your seat, trust me!
All this oomph from a humble 1.2-litre engine - talk about efficient!
For an estimated ₹5.79 lakh to ₹8.80 lakh, the ZXi variant around ₹7.53 lakh is the real MVP - you get LED projector headlamps, 15-inch alloy wheels, a 9-inch touchscreen, and more!
But let's be real, the real question is: can your current ride give you 25.75 kmpl? Didn't think so!
So, are you ready to level up your drive? Follow for more!
